events.title: 500+ WISHLISTS AFTER FIRST DAY OF PAGE LAUNCH!
events.summary: Hello, chemists!Here is Ori, the developer of "Extravalence". First of all, I wanted to say THANK YOU. Because Extravalence has reached 500+ wishlists ONE DAY AFTER THE LAUNCH WITHOUT ANY ADVERTISEMENTS. I am literally shocked right now to see these numbers in less than 24 hours after the page is live. To make it clear, I made "Forsaken Valley", my previous game and it took 9 month to reach the same amount. What I have now is to double the effort to make this game incredible and awesome for you!
